hook.line: If I was starting a brand new business, this is the exact process I'd follow to rank on Google.
hook.visual: Woman in an orange tee on a sofa, twirling an Apple Pencil at the camera, red sparkle title 'HOW TO DO SEO' with a 'STEP-BY-STEP' tag above her head.

beats.what: Face-to-camera promise of her exact process, pencil in hand
Cut to an iPad page of handwritten notes titled 'SEO STRATEGY', with step 1, keyword research
Cut; step 2, on-page optimisation: highlighted checklist (H1, headings, alt text, URL, 300 words)
Page scrolls to step 3, technical SEO: broken links, sitemap, page speed
Pencil points at 'google search console' and 'page speed insights' as she names them
Scroll to step 4, link building: directories, link exchanges, guest posts, digital PR
Step 5, topical authority: blog posts, guides and resources to keep publishing

characters.enters: Twirled in her hand in the opening face shot
characters.acts: Glides over the handwritten notes, pointing to each highlighted item as she says it
characters.exits: Slides out of frame as the page scrolls on

why_it_works: 'If I were starting from zero' framing makes the list feel like a personal, ordered plan rather than generic tips
Handwritten, colour-highlighted notes look like a real cheat sheet, which invites screenshots and saves (135 shares)
The pencil tip lands on each item as she says it, so the eye always knows where to look in a dense page
Numbered headings (1-5) scrolling into view show progress through the plan
weaknesses: She is on camera for only about 7% of the video; after 6 s it is a 65 s scroll over one notes page
Fast 3.9 words/s list of checklist items with no examples or results shown
No CTA and no payoff; it simply stops after step 5
for_robert: Use the pointer move: let Fred act as the pencil, swimming to and tapping each item on a checklist in sync with the words, instead of a static list on screen.
